question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

On the rocks
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"On the rocks"** means being in a state of financial ruin or difficulty. (वित्तीय रूप से बर्बाद)

 
 
• **Example:** After the company lost its major client, it has been **on the rocks **financially.
 
 
 
• **"Financially Ruined"** refers to a state where an individual or organization has lost all their money and is unable to recover financially. (वित्तीय रूप से बर्बाद)
 
 
• **Example:** Many families were **financially ruined** after the economic downturn.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **The specific matter of heart** (दिल का विशेष मामला): Refers to issues or matters related to emotions and relationships.

 
 
• **Example:** Matters of the heart are always complicated and difficult to understand.
 
 
 
• **Totally unexpected** (पूरी तरह से अप्रत्याशित): Refers to something that happens without any prior indication or warning.
 
 
• **Example:** The sudden storm was totally unexpected and caught everyone by surprise.
 
 
 
• **Past one's prime** (अपनी चरम सीमा से परे): Refers to a time when someone or something is no longer in their best condition or period.
 
 
• **Example:** The athlete is past his prime and can no longer compete at the same level.
 
 

39:Tbba,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
